verdict.rationale: The evidence contains nothing about user-defined rules that fire actions automatically on events: no event triggers, schedules, or rule engine are documented. Agent Flows are no-code skills the agent calls during a chat, not event-driven automations, so they are only adjacent. The automatic meeting summaries are a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
